race.comment: SPEEDY TARGET (2) has the most reliable recent profile, coming off consecutive nose seconds and now dropping out of BM55 company on a quick back-up. His record at around 1000m is strong enough for this and the return of a winning rider adds further confidence. AMORE SIRENA (5) is the obvious danger after a clear BM55 win at Gordonvale, where she beat Minnie Vegas by just over three lengths, though she now comes from picnic grade to a harder meeting. POWER PUFF (10) rebounded sharply when third in the same Cairns BM55 that produced SPEEDY TARGET latest placing, and her proven this track-and-distance record gives her a live winning case. TARIFF (4) ran seventh last start at Ewan over 1200m when beaten 4.5 lengths. Expected to go close in this line-up.
